title: Indefinite Demonstrative Pronouns (ceci, cela, ça, ce, ceux-ci, ….)
description: this, that, it — without naming a noun.

items.translation: this — what is near or what is about to be said
items.exampleEn: Listen carefully to this: I am leaving.

items.translation: that — what is further away or what has just been said
items.exampleFr: Il a menti, et cela me déçoit.
items.exampleEn: He lied, and that disappoints me.

items.translation: that / it — the everyday form of cela
items.exampleFr: Ça va ? Je n'aime pas ça.
items.exampleEn: How's it going? I don't like that.

items.translation: it / this / that — before être, or before a relative pronoun
items.exampleFr: C'est vrai. Ce sont mes amis. Ce que je veux.
items.exampleEn: It is true. These are my friends. What I want.

items.translation: this one / that one; in writing, the latter / the former
items.exampleFr: Paul et Marc sont venus ; celui-ci semblait fatigué.
items.exampleEn: Paul and Marc came; the latter seemed tired.

items.prompt: Il a menti, et ___ me déçoit.

items.translation: That said, I understand your choice.

items.prompt: J'ai deux stylos : ___-ci est bleu, celui-là est noir.
Ces livres sont à moi ; ___-là sont à toi.
Paul et Marc sont arrivés ; ___-ci semblait fatigué.
Which pronoun announces what you are about to say?
